paper_title: Analysis of atomic-clock data to constrain variations of fundamental constants
notes: Paper presents measurements of fundamental constant (α, μ) variations using atomic clock frequency ratios (Sr, Yb+, Cs). Section 5.2 interprets these variations as constraints on QCD axion-like couplings to gluons (via coupling to fundamental constants), shown in Figure 10. However, this is an indirect interpretation-based constraint requiring theoretical model assumptions about the cause of fundamental constant variations, not a direct axion measurement. The paper does not present direct experimental bounds on axion couplings themselves, rather reinterprets fundamental constant measurements in axion models. Not included as a measured limit per AxionLimitBench definition of direct experimental exclusions.
